families.description: Garrote the enemy, silencing them for 3 sec causing 810 damage over 18 sec, increased by attack power. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

families.description: Finishing move that stuns the target. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 2 seconds 2 points: 3 seconds 3 points: 4 seconds 4 points: 5 seconds 5 points: 6 seconds

families.name: Mutilate
families.description: Instantly attacks with both weapons for an additional 101 with each weapon. Damage is increased by 50% against Poisoned targets. Must be behind the target. Awards 2 combo points.

families.name: Rupture
families.description: Finishing move that causes damage over time, increased by your attack power. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 324 damage over 8 secs 2 points: 460 damage over 10 secs 3 points: 618 damage over 12 secs 4 points: 798 damage over 14 secs 5 points: 1000 damage over 16 secs

families.description: Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 30%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 seconds 2 points: 12 seconds 3 points: 15 seconds 4 points: 18 seconds 5 points: 21 seconds

families.name: Backstab
families.description: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 255 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

families.name: Evasion
families.description: Increases the rogue's dodge chance by 50% and reduces the chance ranged attacks hit the rogue by 25%. Lasts 15 sec.

families.name: Feint
families.description: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

families.name: Gouge
families.description: Causes 105 damage, incapacitating the opponent for 4 sec, and turns off your attack. Target must be facing you. Any damage caused will revive the target. Awards 1 combo point.

families.name: Kick
families.description: A quick kick that injures a single foe for 110 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

families.name: Shiv
families.description: Performs an instant off-hand weapon attack that automatically applies the poison from your off-hand weapon to the target. Slower weapons require more Energy. Awards 1 combo point.

families.name: Sinister Strike
families.description: An instant strike that causes 98 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point.

families.name: Sprint
families.description: Increases the rogue's movement speed by 70% for 15 sec. Does not break stealth.

families.name: Blind
families.description: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect.

families.name: Cloak of Shadows
families.description: Instantly removes all existing harmful spell effects and increases your chance to resist all spells by 90% for 5 sec. Does not remove effects that prevent you from using Cloak of Shadows.

families.name: Detect Traps
families.description: Greatly increased chance to detect traps.

families.name: Disarm Trap
families.description: Sneak up on the trap in order to disarm it. Don't get too close or the trap will go off.

families.name: Distract
families.description: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby monsters for 10 seconds. Does not break stealth.

families.name: Pick Pocket
families.description: Pick the target's pocket.

families.name: Safe Fall
families.description: Reduces damage from falling.

families.name: Sap
families.description: Incapacitates the target for up to 45 sec. Must be stealthed. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage caused will revive the target. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time.

families.name: Stealth
families.description: Allows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.

families.name: Vanish
families.description: Allows the rogue to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 sec. Also breaks movement impairing effects. More effective than Vanish (Rank 2).

families.name: Poisons
families.description: You can create and mix poisons, with both found and storebought ingredients.

families.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, causing 38 Nature damage and reducing all healing effects used on them by 10% for 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times on a single target.

families.description: Dispels one beneficial Magic effect from the caster and gives them 120 to 154 mana. The dispelled effect must be a priest spell.

families.name: Dispel Magic
families.description: Dispels magic on the target, removing 2 harmful spells from a friend or 2 beneficial spells from an enemy.

families.name: Elune's Grace
families.description: Reduces the chance you'll be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 20% for 15 sec.

families.name: Fear Ward
families.description: Wards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 3 min.

families.name: Feedback
families.description: The priest becomes surrounded with anti-magic energy. Any successful spell cast against the priest will burn 165 of the attacker's Mana, causing 1 Shadow damage for each point of Mana burned. Lasts 15 sec.

families.name: Inner Fire
families.description: A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 1580. Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge. Lasts 10 min or until 20 charges are used.

families.name: Levitate
families.description: Allows the caster to levitate, floating a few feet above the ground. While levitating, you will fall at a reduced speed and travel over water. Any damage will cancel the effect. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Mana Burn
families.description: Destroy 1021 to 1079 mana from a target. For each mana destroyed in this way, the target takes 0.5 Shadow damage.

families.name: Mass Dispel
families.description: Dispels magic in a 15 yard radius, removing 1 harmful spell from each friendly target and 1 beneficial spell from each enemy target. Affects a maximum of 10 friendly targets and 10 enemy targets. This dispel is potent enough to remove Magic effects that are normally undispellable.

families.name: Power Word: Fortitude
families.description: Power infuses the target increasing their Stamina by 79 for 30 min.

families.name: Power Word: Shield
families.description: Draws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 1265 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.

families.name: Prayer of Fortitude
families.description: Power infuses the target's party, increasing their Stamina by 79 for 1 hour.

families.name: Prayer of Spirit
families.description: Power infuses the target's party, increasing their Spirit by 50 for 1 hour.

families.name: Shackle Undead
families.description: Shackles the target undead enemy for up to 50 sec. The shackled unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells. Any damage caused will release the target. Only one target can be shackled at a time.

families.name: Starshards
families.description: Rains starshards down on the enemy target's head, causing 785 Arcane damage over 15 sec.

families.name: Symbol of Hope
families.description: Greatly increases the morale of party members, giving them 33 mana every 5 sec. Effect lasts 15 sec.

families.name: Abolish Disease

families.name: Binding Heal

families.name: Chastise

families.name: Cure Disease

families.name: Desperate Prayer
families.description: Instantly heals the caster for 1637 to 1924.

families.name: Flash Heal
families.description: Heals a friendly target for 1116 to 1295.

families.name: Greater Heal
families.description: A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 2414 to 2803.

families.name: Heal
families.description: Heal your target for 734 to 827.

families.name: Holy Fire
families.description: Consumes the enemy in Holy flames that cause 426 to 537 Holy damage and an additional 165 Holy damage over 10 sec.

families.name: Lesser Heal
families.description: Heal your target for 143 to 165.

families.name: Prayer of Healing
families.description: A powerful prayer heals party members within 30 yards for 1251 to 1322.

families.name: Prayer of Mending
families.description: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 800 the next time they take damage. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time.

families.name: Renew
families.description: Heals the target for 1110 over 15 sec.

families.name: Resurrection
families.description: Brings a dead player back to life with 1100 health and 1150 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

families.name: Smite
families.description: Smite an enemy for 549 to 616 Holy damage.

families.name: Devouring Plague
families.description: Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 1216 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster.

families.name: Fade
families.description: Fade out, discouraging enemies from attacking you for 10 sec. More effective than Fade (Rank 6).

families.name: Hex of Weakness
families.description: Weakens the target enemy, reducing damage caused by 35 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Mind Blast
families.description: Blasts the target for 711 to 752 Shadow damage.

families.name: Mind Control
families.description: Controls a humanoid mind up to level 74, but increases the time between attacks by 25%. Lasts up to 1 min.

families.name: Mind Soothe
families.description: Soothes the target, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid targets level 85 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

families.name: Mind Vision
families.description: Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.

families.name: Prayer of Shadow Protection
families.description: Power infuses the target's party, increasing their Shadow resistance by 70 for 20 min.

families.name: Psychic Scream
families.description: The caster lets out a psychic scream, causing 5 enemies within 8 yards to flee for 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

families.name: Shadow Protection
families.description: Increases the target's resistance to Shadow spells by 70 for 10 min.

families.name: Shadow Word: Death
families.description: A word of dark binding that inflicts 572 to 664 Shadow damage to the target. If the target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, the caster takes damage equal to the damage inflicted upon the target.

families.name: Shadow Word: Pain
families.description: A word of darkness that causes 1236 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

families.name: Shadowfiend
families.description: Creates a shadowy fiend to attack the target. Caster receives mana when the Shadowfiend deals damage. Lasts 15 sec.

families.name: Shadowguard
families.description: The caster is surrounded by shadows. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 130 Shadow damage. Attackers can only be damaged once every few seconds. This damage causes no threat. 3 charges. Lasts 10 min.

families.name: Touch of Weakness
families.description: The next melee attack on the caster will cause 80 Shadow damage and reduce the damage caused by the attacker by 35 for 2 min.

families.name: Chain Lightning
families.description: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 734 to 838 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.

families.name: Earth Shock
families.description: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 661 to 696 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec.

families.name: Earthbind Totem
families.description: Summons an Earthbind Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 45 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards.

families.name: Fire Elemental Totem
families.description: Summons an elemental totem that calls forth a greater fire elemental to rain destruction on the caster's enemies. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Fire Nova Totem
families.description: Summons a Fire Nova Totem that has 5 health and lasts 5 sec. Unless it is destroyed within 4 sec., the totem inflicts 654 to 730 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd.

families.name: Flame Shock
families.description: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 377 Fire damage immediately and 420 Fire damage over 12 sec.

families.name: Frost Shock
families.description: Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 647 to 683 Frost damage and slowing movement speed to 50% of normal. Lasts 8 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.

families.name: Lightning Bolt
families.description: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 571 to 652 Nature damage.

families.name: Magma Totem
families.description: Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 20 sec that causes 97 Fire damage to creatures within 8 yards every 2 seconds.

families.name: Purge
families.description: Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial magic effects.

families.name: Searing Totem
families.description: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 1 min that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 50 to 66 Fire damage.

families.name: Stoneclaw Totem
families.description: Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 1324 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within 8 yards to attack it. Enemies attacking the Stoneclaw Totem have a 50% chance to be stunned for 3 sec.

families.name: Astral Recall
families.description: Yanks the caster through the twisting nether back to Hearthstone Location. Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.

families.name: Bloodlust
families.description: Increases melee, ranged, and spell casting speed by 30% for all party members. Lasts 40 sec.

families.name: Earth Elemental Totem
families.description: Summon an elemental totem that calls forth a greater earth elemental to protect the caster and his allies. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Far Sight
families.description: Changes the caster's viewpoint to the targeted location. Lasts 1 min. Only useable outdoors.

families.name: Fire Resistance Totem
families.description: Summons a Fire Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 2 min that increases the fire resistance of party members within 20 yards by 70.

families.name: Flametongue Totem
families.description: Summons a Flametongue Totem that enchants all party members' main-hand weapons with fire if they are within 20 yards. Each hit causes 19.4 to 59.7 additional Fire damage. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Flametongue Weapon
families.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes 46 to 140 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts 30 minutes.

families.name: Frost Resistance Totem
families.description: Summons a Frost Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 2 min. The totem increases party members' frost resistance by 70, if within 20 yards.

families.name: Frostbrand Weapon
families.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with frost. Each hit has a chance of causing 246 additional Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 25% for 8 sec. Lasts 30 minutes.

families.name: Ghost Wolf
families.description: Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors.

families.name: Grace of Air Totem
families.description: Summons a Grace of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the agility of party members within 20 yards by 77. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Grounding Totem
families.description: Summons a Grounding Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that will redirect one harmful spell cast on a nearby party member to itself, destroying the totem. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 45 sec.

families.name: Heroism
families.description: Increases melee, ranged, and spell haste by 30% for all party and raid members. Lasts 40 sec. Allies receiving this effect will become Exhausted and be unable to benefit from Heroism again for 10 min.

families.name: Lightning Shield
families.description: The caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 287 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every few seconds. Lasts 10 min. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

families.name: Nature Resistance Totem
families.description: Summons a Nature Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 2 min that increases the nature resistance of party members within 20 yards by 70.

families.name: Rockbiter Weapon
families.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing its damage per second by 62. Lasts 30 minutes.

families.name: Sentry Totem
families.description: Summons an immobile Sentry Totem with 100 health at your feet for 5 min that allows vision of nearby area and warns of enemies that attack it. Right-Click on buff to switch back and forth between totem sight and shaman sight.

families.name: Stoneskin Totem
families.description: Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 20 yards, reducing melee damage taken by 43. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Strength of Earth Totem
families.description: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party members within 20 yards by 86. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Water Breathing
families.description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

families.name: Water Walking
families.description: Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Any damage will cancel the effect.

families.name: Windfury Totem
families.description: Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enchants all party members main-hand weapons with wind, if they are within 20 yards. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with 445 extra attack power. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Windfury Weapon
families.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of dealing additional damage equal to two extra attacks with 475 extra attack power. Lasts 30 minutes.

families.name: Windwall Totem
families.description: Summons a Windwall Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 20 yards, reducing ranged damage taken by 102. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Wrath of Air Totem
families.description: Summons a Wrath of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. Party members within 20 yards of the totem have their spell damage and healing increased by up to 101. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Ancestral Spirit
families.description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 600 health and 800 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

families.name: Chain Heal
families.description: Heals the friendly target for 833 to 950, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump reduces the effectiveness of the heal by 50%. Heals 3 total targets.

families.name: Cure Disease
families.description: Cures 1 disease on the target.

families.name: Cure Poison
families.description: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

families.name: Disease Cleansing Totem
families.description: Summons a Disease Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease effect from party members within 20 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Healing Stream Totem
families.description: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 2 min that heals group members within 20 yards for 18 every 2 seconds.

families.name: Healing Wave
families.description: Heals a friendly target for 2134 to 2436.

families.name: Lesser Healing Wave
families.description: Heals a friendly target for 1051 to 1198.

families.name: Mana Spring Totem

families.name: Poison Cleansing Totem
families.description: Summons a Poison Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 poison effect from party members within 20 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Reincarnation
families.description: Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.

families.name: Totemic Call
families.description: Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Call.

families.name: Tranquil Air Totem
families.description: Summons a Tranquil Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem reduces the threat caused by all party members within 20 yards by 20%. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Tremor Totem
families.description: Summons a Tremor Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within 30 yards. Lasts 2 min.

families.name: Water Shield
families.description: The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water, granting 50 mana per 5 sec. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, 204 mana is restored to the caster. This expends one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

families.name: Amplify Magic
families.description: Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing damage taken from spells by up to 120 and healing spells by up to 240. Lasts 10 min.

families.name: Arcane Blast
families.description: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 668 to 772 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, the casting time is reduced while mana cost is increased. Effect stacks up to 3 times and lasts 8 sec.

families.name: Arcane Brilliance
families.description: Infuses the target's party with brilliance, increasing their Intellect by 40 for 1 hour.

families.name: Arcane Explosion
families.description: Causes an explosion of arcane magic around the caster, causing 377 to 407 Arcane damage to all targets within 10 yards.

families.name: Arcane Intellect
families.description: Increases the target's Intellect by 40 for 30 min.

families.name: Arcane Missiles
families.description: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 286 Arcane damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

families.name: Blink
families.description: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way. Also frees the caster from stuns and bonds.

families.name: Conjure Food
families.description: Conjures 10 croissants, providing the mage and his allies with something to eat. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

families.name: Conjure Mana Agate
families.description: Conjures a mana agate that can be used to instantly restore 390 to 410 mana. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

families.name: Conjure Mana Citrine
families.description: Conjures a mana citrine that can be used to instantly restore 829 to 871 mana. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

families.name: Conjure Mana Emerald
families.description: Conjures a mana emerald that can be used to instantly restore 2340 to 2460 mana. 3 charges. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

families.name: Conjure Mana Jade
families.description: Conjures a mana jade that can be used to instantly restore 585 to 615 mana. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

families.name: Conjure Mana Ruby
families.description: Conjures a mana ruby that can be used to instantly restore 1073 to 1127 mana. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

families.name: Conjure Water
families.description: Conjures 10 skin of glacier water, providing the mage and his allies with something to drink. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

families.name: Counterspell
families.description: Counters the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 8 sec. Generates a high amount of threat.

families.name: Dampen Magic
families.description: Dampens magic used against the targeted party member, decreasing damage taken from spells by up to 120 and healing spells by up to 240. Lasts 10 min.

families.name: Evocation

families.name: Invisibility

families.description: Increases your resistance to all magic by 18 and allows 30% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

families.name: Mana Shield
families.description: Absorbs 715 damage, draining mana instead. Drains 2 mana per damage absorbed. Lasts 1 min.

families.name: Polymorph
families.description: Transforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 50 sec. While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

families.description: Blasts the enemy for 664 to 786 Fire damage.

families.name: Fireball
families.description: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 717 to 913 Fire damage and an additional 84 Fire damage over 8 sec.

families.name: Flamestrike
families.description: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 480 to 585 Fire damage and an additional 424 Fire damage over 8 sec.

families.name: Molten Armor
families.description: Causes 75 Fire damage when hit, increases your chance to critically hit with spells by 3%, and reduces the chance you are critically hit by 5%. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

families.name: Scorch
families.description: Scorch the enemy for 305 to 361 Fire damage.

families.name: Blizzard
families.description: Ice shards pelt the target area doing (185 * 8) Frost damage over 8 sec.

families.name: Cone of Cold
families.description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 418 to 457 Frost damage and are slowed by 50% for 8 sec.

families.name: Frost Armor
families.description: Increases Armor by 200. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

families.name: Frost Nova
families.description: Blasts enemies near the caster for 100 to 113 Frost damage and freezes them in place for up to 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

families.name: Frost Ward
families.description: Absorbs 1125 Frost damage. Lasts 30 sec.

families.name: Frostbolt
families.description: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 630 to 680 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 9 sec.

families.name: Ice Armor
families.description: Increases Armor by 645 and frost resistance by 18. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

families.name: Ice Block
families.description: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move or cast spells. Also causes Hypothermia, preventing you from recasting Ice Block for 30 sec.

families.name: Ice Lance
families.description: Deals 173 to 200 Frost damage to an enemy target. Causes triple damage against Frozen targets.

families.name: Corruption
families.description: Corrupts the target, causing 900 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

families.name: Curse of Agony
families.description: Curses the target with agony, causing 1356 Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Curse reaches its full duration. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

families.name: Curse of Doom
families.description: Curses the target with impending doom, causing 4200 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players.

families.name: Curse of Recklessness
families.description: Curses the target with recklessness, increasing melee attack power by 135 but reducing armor by 800 for 2 min. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

families.name: Curse of the Elements
families.description: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Arcane, Fire, Frost, and Shadow resistances by 88 and increasing Arcane, Fire, Frost, and Shadow damage taken by 10%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

families.name: Curse of Tongues
families.description: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 60%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.

families.name: Curse of Weakness
families.description: Target's melee attack power is reduced by 350 for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

families.name: Death Coil
families.description: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 526 Shadow damage. The caster gains 100% of the damage caused in health.

families.name: Drain Life
families.description: Transfers 108 health every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

families.name: Drain Mana
families.description: Transfers 200 Mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

families.name: Drain Soul
families.description: Drains the soul of the target, causing 620 Shadow damage over 15 sec. If the target dies while being drained, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.

families.name: Fear
families.description: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

families.name: Howl of Terror
families.description: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

families.name: Life Tap
families.description: Converts 582 health into 582 mana.

families.name: Seed of Corruption
families.description: Imbeds a demon seed in the enemy target, causing 1044 Shadow damage over 18 sec. When the target takes 1044 total damage or dies, the seed will inflict 1110 to 1290 Shadow damage to all other enemies within 15 yards of the target. Only one Corruption spell per Warlock can be active on any one target.

families.name: Banish
families.description: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 30 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Only works on Demons and Elementals.

families.name: Create Firestone
families.description: Creates a Master Firestone which can be equipped. When equipped, enchants the main hand weapon with fire, granting each attack a chance to deal 116 to 174 additional Fire damage. In addition, equipping the Master Firestone increases the damage done by fire spells by 30. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

families.name: Create Healthstone
families.description: Creates a Master Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 2080 health. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

families.name: Create Soulstone
families.description: Creates a Master Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 2900 health and 3300 mana. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

families.name: Create Spellstone
families.description: Creates a Master Spellstone for the caster. When equipped and used, the Master Spellstone dispels all harmful magic effects from the caster. In addition, equipping the Spellstone improves your spell critical strike rating by 20. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

families.name: Demon Armor
families.description: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 660, Shadow resistance by 18 and restores 18 health every 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Warlock at any time. Lasts 30 min.

families.name: Demon Skin
families.description: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 120 and restores 5 Health per 5 sec. for 30 min.

families.name: Detect Invisibility
families.description: Allows the friendly target to detect lesser invisibility for 10 min.

families.name: Eye of Kilrogg
families.description: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye moves quickly but is very fragile.

families.name: Fel Armor
families.description: Surrounds the caster with fel energy, increasing the amount of health generated through spells and effects by 20% and increasing spell damage by up to 100. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Warlock at any time. Lasts 30 min.

families.name: Health Funnel
families.description: Gives 188 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels.

families.name: Inferno
families.description: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 5 min. Once control is lost, the Infernal must be Subjugated to maintain control. Can only be used outdoors.

families.name: Ritual of Doom
families.description: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard. The doomguard must be immediately subjugated or it will attack the ritual participants. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

families.name: Ritual of Souls
families.description: Begins a ritual that creates a Soulwell. Raid members can click the Soulwell to acquire a Master Healthstone. The Soulwell lasts for 3 min or 10 charges. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the soul portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

families.name: Ritual of Summoning
families.description: Begins a ritual that summons the targeted group member. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

families.name: Sense Demons
families.description: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap until cancelled. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

families.name: Shadow Ward
families.description: Absorbs 875 shadow damage. Lasts 30 sec.

families.name: Soulshatter
families.description: Reduces threat by 50% for all enemies within 50 yards.

families.name: Subjugate Demon
families.description: Subjugates the target demon, up to level 74, forcing it to do your bidding. While subjugated, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 40% and its casting speed is slowed by 30%. Lasts up to 5 min. If you repeatedly subjugate the same demon, it will become more difficult to control with each attempt.

families.name: Summon Dreadsteed
families.description: Summons a Dreadsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster. Speed is increased by 100%.

families.name: Summon Felhunter
families.description: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.

families.name: Summon Felsteed
families.description: Summons a Felsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster. Speed is increased by 60%.

families.name: Summon Imp

families.name: Summon Succubus
families.description: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.

families.name: Summon Voidwalker
families.description: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.

families.name: Unending Breath

families.name: Hellfire
families.description: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing 308 Fire damage to himself and 308 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

families.name: Immolate
families.description: Burns the enemy for 332 Fire damage and then an additional 615 Fire damage over 15 sec.

families.name: Incinerate
families.description: Deals 444 to 514 Fire damage to your target and an additional 111 to 128 Fire damage if the target is affected by an Immolate spell.

families.name: Rain of Fire
families.description: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for (304 * 4) Fire damage over 8 sec.

families.name: Searing Pain
families.description: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 270 to 320 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.

families.name: Shadow Bolt
families.description: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 544 to 607 Shadow damage.

families.name: Soul Fire
families.description: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 1003 to 1257 Fire damage.

families.name: Lasting Afflictions
families.description: Increases the duration of your Corruption and Unstable Affliction spells by 6 secs, the duration of your Curse of Agony spell by 4 secs and reduces the chance your Afflicition spells will be dispelled by an additional 30%.

families.name: Barkskin
families.description: The druid's skin becomes as tough as bark. All damage taken is reduced by 20%. While protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. This spell is usable while stunned, frozen, incapacitated, feared or asleep. Lasts 12 sec.

families.name: Cyclone
families.description: Tosses the enemy target into the air, preventing all action but making them invulnerable for up to 6 sec. Only one target can be affected by your Cyclone at a time.

families.name: Entangling Roots
families.description: Roots the target in place and causes 351 Nature damage over 27 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only useable outdoors.

families.name: Faerie Fire
families.description: Decrease the armor of the target by 610 for 40 sec. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

families.name: Hibernate
families.description: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 40 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

families.name: Hurricane
families.description: Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 206 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks by 25%. Lasts 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

families.name: Innervate
families.description: Increases the target's Spirit based mana regeneration by 400% and allows full mana regeneration while casting. Lasts 20 sec.

families.name: Moonfire
families.description: Burns the enemy for 305 to 357 Arcane damage and then an additional 600 Arcane damage over 12 sec.

families.name: Soothe Animal
families.description: Soothes the target beast, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Beast targets level 85 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

families.name: Starfire
families.description: Causes 550 to 647 Arcane damage to the target.

families.name: Teleport: Moonglade
families.description: Teleports the caster to the Moonglade.

families.name: Thorns
families.description: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 25 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.

families.name: Wrath
families.description: Causes 383 to 432 Nature damage to the target.

families.name: Aquatic Form
families.description: Shapeshift into aquatic form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

families.name: Bash
families.description: Stuns the target for 4 sec.

families.name: Bear Form
families.description: Shapeshift into bear form, increasing melee attack power by 120, armor contribution from items by 180%, and Stamina by 25%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

families.name: Cat Form
families.description: Shapeshift into cat form, increasing melee attack power by 40 plus Agility. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

families.name: Challenging Roar
families.description: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

families.name: Claw
families.description: Claw the enemy, causing 190 additional damage. Awards 1 combo point.

families.name: Cower
families.description: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

families.name: Dash
families.description: Increases movement speed by 70% for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.

families.name: Demoralizing Roar
families.description: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 248. Lasts 30 sec.

families.name: Dire Bear Form
families.description: Shapeshift into dire bear form, increasing melee attack power by 210, armor contribution from items by 400%, and Stamina by 25%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

families.name: Enrage
families.description: Generates 20 rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form.

families.name: Feline Grace
families.description: Reduces damage from falling.

families.name: Ferocious Bite
families.description: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 4.0999999 additional damage. Damage is increased by your attack power. 1 point : 259-292 damage 2 points: 428-461 damage 3 points: 597-630 damage 4 points: 766-799 damage 5 points: 935-968 damage

families.name: Flight Form
families.description: Shapeshift into flight form, increasing movement speed by 60% and allowing you to fly. Cannot use in combat. Can only use this form in Outland. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

families.name: Frenzied Regeneration
families.description: Converts up to 10 rage per second into health for 10 sec. Each point of rage is converted into 25 health.

families.name: Growl
families.description: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

families.name: Lacerate
families.description: Lacerates the enemy target, dealing 31 bleed damage and making them bleed for 155 damage over 15 sec and causing a high amount of threat. Damage increased by attack power. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

families.name: Maim
families.description: Finishing move that causes damage and incapacitates the target. Any directly damaging attack will revive the target. Causes more damage and lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : (84 + 45 + Mainhand weapon min damage)-(84 + 45 + Mainhand weapon max damage) damage, 2 sec 2 points: (84 * 2 + 45 + Mainhand weapon min damage)-(84 * 2 + 45 + Mainhand weapon max damage) damage, 3 sec 3 points: (84 * 3 + 45 + Mainhand weapon min damage)-(84 * 3 + 45 + Mainhand weapon max damage) damage, 4 sec 4 points: (84 * 4 + 45 + Mainhand weapon min damage)-(84 * 4 + 45 + Mainhand weapon max damage) damage, 5 sec 5 points: (84 * 5 + 45 + Mainhand weapon min damage)-(84 * 5 + 45 + Mainhand weapon max damage) damage, 6 sec

families.name: Mangle (Bear)
families.description: Mangle the target for 115% normal damage plus 155 and causes the target to take 30% additional damage from Shred and bleed effects for 12 sec.

families.name: Mangle (Cat)
families.description: Mangle the target for 160% normal damage plus 264 and causes the target to take 30% additional damage from Shred and bleed effects for 12 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

families.name: Maul
families.description: Increases the druid's next attack by 176 damage.

families.name: Pounce
families.description: Pounce, stunning the target for 3 sec and causing 600 damage over 18 sec. Must be prowling. Awards 1 combo point.

families.name: Primal Fury
families.description: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage anytime you get a critical strike while in Bear and Dire Bear Form.

families.name: Prowl
families.description: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.

families.name: Rake
families.description: Rake the target for (Attack Power / 100 + 78) bleed damage and an additional (36 * 3 + Attack Power * 0.06) damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

families.name: Ravage
families.description: Ravage the target, causing 385% damage plus 514 to the target. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

families.name: Rip
families.description: Finishing move that causes damage over time. Damage increases per combo point and by your attack power: 1 point : 300 damage over 12 sec. 2 points: 498 damage over 12 sec. 3 points: 696 damage over 12 sec. 4 points: 894 damage over 12 sec. 5 points: 1092 damage over 12 sec.

families.name: Shred
families.description: Shred the target, causing 225% damage plus 405 to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

families.name: Swift Flight Form
families.description: Shapeshift into swift flight form, increasing movement speed by 280% and allowing you to fly. Cannot use in combat. Can only use this form in Outland. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

families.name: Swipe
families.description: Swipe 3 nearby enemies, inflicting 84 damage. Damage increased by attack power.

families.name: Tiger's Fury
families.description: Increases damage done by 40 for 6 sec.

families.name: Track Humanoids
families.description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one type of thing can be tracked at a time.

families.name: Travel Form
families.description: Shapeshift into travel form, increasing movement speed by 40%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only useable outdoors. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

families.name: Abolish Poison
families.description: Attempts to cure 1 poison effect on the target, and 1 more poison effect every 2 seconds for 8 sec.

families.name: Cure Poison
families.description: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

families.name: Gift of the Wild
families.description: Gives the Gift of the Wild to the target's party, increasing armor by 340, all attributes by 14 and all resistances by 25 for 1 hour.

families.name: Healing Touch
families.description: Heals a friendly target for 2715 to 3206.

families.name: Lifebloom
families.description: Heals the target for 273 over 7 sec. When Lifebloom completes its duration or is dispelled, the target instantly heals themself for 600. This effect can stack up to 3 times on the same target.

families.name: Mark of the Wild
families.description: Increases the friendly target's armor by 340, all attributes by 14 and all resistances by 25 for 30 min.

families.name: Rebirth
families.description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 3200 health and 3200 mana.

families.name: Regrowth
families.description: Heals a friendly target for 1253 to 1394 and another 1274 over 21 sec.

families.name: Rejuvenation
families.description: Heals the target for 1060 over 12 sec.

families.name: Remove Curse
families.description: Dispels 1 Curse from a friendly target.

families.name: Tranquility
families.description: Heals all nearby group members for 1518 every 2 seconds for 8 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

families.name: Auto Shot
families.description: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled.

families.name: Hearthstone
families.description: Returns you to Hearthstone Location. Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.

families.name: Shoot Bow
families.description: Shoot the target with an equipped bow.

families.name: Shoot Crossbow
families.description: Shoot the target with an equipped crossbow.

families.name: Shoot Gun

families.name: Arcane Torrent
families.description: Silence all enemies within 8 yards for 2 sec. In addition, you gain 10 Mana for each Mana Tap charge currently affecting you.

families.name: Axe Specialization
families.description: Expertise with Axes and Two-Handed Axes increased by 5.

families.name: Beast Slaying
families.description: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

families.name: Berserking
families.description: Increases your attack speed by 10% to 30%. At full health the speed increase is 10% with a greater effect up to 30% if you are badly hurt when you activate Berserking. Lasts 10 sec.

families.name: Blood Fury
families.description: Increases your damage and healing from spells and effects by up to 5, but reduces healing effects on you by 50%. Lasts 15 sec.

families.name: Bow Specialization
families.description: Your chance to critically hit with Bows is increased by 1%.

families.name: Cannibalize
families.description: When activated, regenerates 7% of total health every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

families.name: Command
families.description: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.

families.name: Cultivation
families.description: Herbalism skill increased by 15.

families.name: Diplomacy
families.description: Reputation gains increased by 10%.

families.name: Endurance
families.description: Total Health increased by 5%.

families.name: Engineering Specialization
families.description: Engineering skill increased by 15.

families.name: Escape Artist
families.description: Escape the effects of any immobilization or movement speed reduction effect.

families.name: Expansive Mind
families.description: Intellect increased by 5%.

families.name: Find Treasure
families.description: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap. Lasts until cancelled.

families.name: Frost Resistance
families.description: Frost resistance increased by 10.

families.name: Gemcutting
families.description: Jewelcrafting skill increased by 5.

families.name: Gift of the Naaru
families.description: Heals the target of 50 damage over 15 sec.

families.name: Gun Specialization
families.description: Your chance to critically hit with Guns is increased by 1%.

families.name: Hardiness
families.description: Chance to resist Stun effects increased by an additional 15%.

families.name: Heroic Presence
families.description: Increases chance to hit by 1% for you and all party members within 30 yards.

families.name: Inspiring Presence
families.description: Increases chance to hit with spells by 1% for you and all party members within 30 yards.

families.name: Mace Specialization
families.description: Expertise with Maces and Two-Handed Maces increased by 5.

families.name: Magic Resistance
families.description: All resistances increased by 5.

families.name: Mana Tap
families.description: Reduces target's mana by 50 and charges you with Arcane energy for 10 min. This effect stacks up to 3 times.

families.name: Nature Resistance
families.description: Nature Resistance increased by 10.

families.name: Perception
families.description: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

families.name: Quickness
families.description: Dodge chance increased by 1%.

families.name: Regeneration
families.description: Health regeneration rate increased by 10%. 10% of total Health regeneration may continue during combat.

families.name: Shadow Resistance
families.description: Shadow Resistance increased by 10.

families.name: Shadowmeld
families.description: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Night Elf Rogues and Druids with Shadowmeld are more difficult to detect while stealthed or prowling.

families.name: Stoneform
families.description: While active, grants immunity to Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects. In addition, Armor increased by 10%. Lasts 8 sec.

families.name: Sword Specialization
families.description: Expertise with Swords and Two-Handed Swords increased by 5.

families.name: The Human Spirit
families.description: Spirit increased by 10%.

families.name: Throwing Specialization
families.description: Your chance to critically hit with Throwing Weapons is increased by 1%.

families.name: Underwater Breathing
families.description: Underwater breath lasts 300% longer than normal.

families.name: War Stomp
families.description: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

families.name: Will of the Forsaken
families.description: Provides immunity to Charm, Fear and Sleep while active. May also be used while already afflicted by Charm, Fear or Sleep. Lasts 5 sec.

families.name: Wisp Spirit
families.description: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing speed by 50%.

families.name: Alchemy
families.description: Allows an alchemist to brew extraordinary potions up to a maximum potential skill of 375.

families.name: Elixir Master
families.description: Allows an alchemist to sometimes create an additional elixir when brewing high level elixirs.

families.name: Potion Master
families.description: Allows an alchemist to sometimes create an additional potion when brewing high level potions.

families.name: Transmutation Master
families.description: Allows an Alchemist to sometimes to get greater results when transmuting materials.

families.name: Armorsmith
families.description: Allows a blacksmith to make special armors that are unavailable to the typical blacksmith.

families.name: Blacksmithing
families.description: Allows a Blacksmith to make weapons and armor up to a maximum potential skill of 375.

families.name: Master Axesmith
families.description: Allows a blacksmith to make special axes that are unavailable to the typical artisan weaponsmith.

families.name: Master Hammersmith
families.description: Allows a blacksmith to make special maces and hammers that are unavailable to the typical artisan weaponsmith.

families.name: Master Swordsmith
families.description: Allows a blacksmith to make special Swords that are unavailable to the typical artisan weaponsmith.

families.name: Weaponsmith
families.description: Allows a blacksmith to make special weapons that are unavailable to the typical blacksmith.

families.name: Disenchant
families.description: Extracts the magical element(s) from good quality (Green) or better weapons or armor. The targeted item will be DESTROYED and will not be retrievable.

families.name: Enchanting
families.description: Allows an enchanter to put masterful enchantments on weapons and armor up to a maximum potential skill of 375.

families.name: Engineering
families.description: Allows an engineer to make bombs and gizmos that very often work as intended up to a maximum potential skill of 375.

families.name: Gnomish Engineer
families.description: Allows an engineer to make fantastic, yet unreliable gnomish devices.

families.name: Goblin Engineer
families.description: Allows an engineer to make lethal goblin devices.

families.name: Jewelcrafting
families.description: Allows a jewelcrafter to make fantastic jewelry, up to a maximum potential skill of 375.

families.name: Prospecting
families.description: Search 5 ore of a base metal for precious gems. This will destroy the ore in the process.

families.name: Find Herbs
families.description: Nearby herb bushes appear on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

families.name: Herb Gathering
families.description: How to find and gather Outland herbs. Gives a potential herbalism skill of 375.

families.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
families.description: Allows a leatherworker to make special dragonscale armors that are unavailable to a normal leatherworker. Dragonscale armor is all mail armor.

families.name: Elemental Leatherworking
families.description: Allows a leatherworker to make special elemental armors that are unavailable to a normal leatherworker.

families.name: Leatherworking
families.description: Allows a leatherworker to make master quality leather armors, up to a maximum potential skill of 375.

families.name: Tribal Leatherworking
families.description: Allows a leatherworker to make special tribal armors that are unavailable to a normal leatherworker.

families.name: Find Minerals
families.description: Nearby mineral veins appear on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

families.name: Mining
families.description: You are a Master Miner. Gives a potential mining skill of 375.

families.name: Smelting
families.description: Allows the miner to turn ore into metal bars. This skill requires a forge.

families.name: Skinning
families.description: Master skill in skinning the hides from beasts for use in Leatherworking. Gives a potential skinning skill of 375. Requires a Skinning Knife.

families.name: Mooncloth Tailoring
families.description: Allows the tailor access to special self-only mooncloth recipes and to create an additional primal mooncloth at a moonwell.

families.name: Shadoweave Tailoring
families.description: Allows the tailor access to special self-only shadoweave recipes and to create an additional shadowcloth at the altar of shadows.

families.name: Spellfire Tailoring
families.description: Allows the tailor access to special self-only spellfire recipes and to create an additional spellcloth in netherstorm.

families.name: Tailoring
families.description: Allows a tailor to make incomparable shirts and armors up to a maximum potential skill of 375.

families.name: Cooking
families.description: Allows a cook to make amazing recipes up to a maximum potential skill of 375.

families.name: First Aid
families.description: Allows a physician to make and use bandages up to a potential skill of 375. The cloth used to make those bandages are found on humanoids in the world.

families.name: Find Fish
families.description: Nearby fishing nodes appear on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

families.name: Fishing
families.description: Equip a fishing pole and find a body of water to fish. Right-Click on the bob in the water when it splashes to catch your fish. Higher skill increases your chance of fishing successfully in higher level areas.
